Name: Meeting Rafayel(Love and Deepspace) English Translation
Author: fenveon
Description:
[size=4]After 4 days of translating and having to fix the translation twice after it said not translation, I have FINALLY finished translating this mod. I used a translator for the most part, but I did take lines from the game itself whenever certain lines looked familiar. This is also to say that certain lines may not translated in the best way since I couldn't read all the nuances original lines had.[/size]

[size=4]You guys can edit the translation as you like (especially since I have a feeling that I might have messed up somewhere) just don't upload any edited versions of my translation. This also goes for unedited versions as well. If you found a line that translated incorrectly or could've been reworded better, pls let me know. I'll try edit the translation as best I can (keyword on the word "try" since I am a college student who is just doing this as a passion project).[/size]

Downloads.Description: Pls also download the original mod as well. This will not work if you don't have it.
